verdict.rationale: TaxJar's AutoFile is documented as handling state sales tax returns and remittances automatically, migrating reports into returns for on-time filing, and being 'backed by our guarantee' (taxjar-docs-6, taxjar-docs-17, taxjar-docs-24). That covers the core of automated, on-time filing and remittance. Missing for 10: explicit terms showing the guarantee covers late-filing penalties, evidence of coverage beyond US state-level returns (scope is stated as US-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration of AutoFile reliability.
